questions_and_answers.question_text: How are days of the month expressed?
In what other context have you already seen the bound word -hào?
Which question word is used for days of the month?
How high a number may answer the jǐhào question?
Write the Chinese question asking for both month and day of birth.
Which bound word follows the number of the day?
Write the Chinese for "I was born on the fourth."
Write the Chinese for "I was born on August 9."
In what order are the month and the day given?

answers.answer_text: The month comes first, then the day — jǐyuè jǐhào.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Is jǐ- still used even when the answer may be as high as 31?

answers.answer_text: Yes — jǐ- is used for days of the month regardless.

articles.text:
6. A: Nǐ shi jǐhào shēngde?                 What day of the month were you
                                            born?
   B: Wǒ shi Sìhào shēngde.                 I was born on the fourth.

Notes on No. 6

Days of the month are expressed by the number of the day followed by the bound word -hào. You will remember that -hào is also used in giving addresses.

In asking about days of the month, jǐ-, "how many," is used, even though the question may be answered by a number as high as 31.

The month and day of the month may be given together. For example,

Nǐ shi jǐyuè jǐhào shēngde?      What is your month and day of
                                 birth?
Wǒ shi Bāyuè jiǔhào shēngde.     I was born on August 9.
